intent: Inspect and refactor ApplicationYml without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Runtime configuration artifact src/main/resources/application.yml in FLAT dotted-key style (never mix nested mappings). TWO documents separated by ---. DOCUMENT 1 (base, production-shaped, BARE placeholders only, no H2 anywhere): spring.application.name: telemetry-ingestion-processing; spring.r2dbc.url: ${TELEMETRY_R2DBC_URL}; spring.r2dbc.username: ${TELEMETRY_DB_USER}; spring.r2dbc.password: ${TELEMETRY_DB_PASSWORD}; spring.flyway.enabled: true; spring.flyway.url: ${TELEMETRY_JDBC_URL} (a DISTINCT variable for the JDBC scheme, read by Flyway only); spring.flyway.user: ${TELEMETRY_DB_USER}; spring.flyway.password: ${TELEMETRY_DB_PASSWORD}; spring.flyway.locations: filesystem:db/migrations. telemetry.reorder-window: PT60S; telemetry.reorder-buffer-capacity: 4096; telemetry.validated-stream-capacity: 1024; telemetry.broadcast-capacity: 1024; telemetry.emit-retry-timeout: PT0.1S; telemetry.boundaries[i] entries (keys metric, min, max, min-exclusive, enabled): HEART_RATE 30..240 inclusive enabled=true; POWER 0..2500 enabled=true; CADENCE 0..220 enabled=true; SWIM_PACE min 45 max 100000 min-exclusive=true enabled=true (pace > 45 sec/100m); GROUND_CONTACT_TIME, RESPIRATION, SWIM_STROKE min 0 max 0 enabled=false (ranges unspecified, left unbounded). Observability literals: logging.level.root: INFO; logging.level.com.blackboard.telemetry: INFO; logging.file.name: logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log; logging.structured.format.file: ecs (ECS JSON lines rolling file sink, shipped by the platform, no runtime dependency on any log tool); logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-file-size: 10MB; logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-history: 7; management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: health,metrics (Micrometer via actuator, no scrape/push exporter). DOCUMENT 2 (test profile): spring.config.activate.on-profile: test; spring.r2dbc.url: r2dbc:h2:mem:///telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE; spring.r2dbc.username: sa; spring.r2dbc.password: '' ; spring.flyway.enabled: true; spring.flyway.url: jdbc:h2:mem:telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE; spring.flyway.user: sa; spring.flyway.password: ''; spring.flyway.locations: filesystem:db/migrations; logging.file.name: target/test-logs/telemetry.log. The profile is activated by the scaffold's test-scoped property spring.profiles.active=test. Every value is consumed through TelemetryProperties or the Spring Boot runtime readers; the file owns every operational literal.
